tb-2080ec70d8a794c1df2c163b1b14bd7f-0004.heading: Step 4: Conduct the Rulemaking Process
tb-2080ec70d8a794c1df2c163b1b14bd7f-0004.content:
STEP 4Conduct the Rulemaking Process
AEngage with the EPA to ensure all required components are included in the UAA package prior to public outreach.
BEngage the EPA for pre-proposal review and discussion (in addition to being engaged throughout the process, this crucial step allows for yet another opportunity for issues to be raised to be resolved in a timely fashion).
CPropose use revisions with the supporting UAA and ensure that all public participation requirements have been met (e.g., public notice, public hearing).
DAddress public comments and make any corresponding revisions.
EAdopt final revisions into the WQS regulations and submit them along with the UAA to the EPA.
FAfter receiving the complete WQS revisions package including the UAA, the EPA will review the revisions for approval or disapproval. The Statutory timeframe for EPA action is 60 days to approve and 90 days to disapprove. The use revision becomes effective for CWA purposes upon EPA approval.
